segments.en: Today I practise computer English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I say "variable" when I talk about my computer project. I say "value" when I talk about my computer project. I say "string" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use variable, value, and string. At the end, I say: I can use variable clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“变量与数据类型”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。variable：变量，用名字保存一个可以使用或改变的值。示例：I learned how to use "variable" in a computer task.value：值，变量实际保存的内容。示例：I learned how to use "value" in a computer task.string：字符串，由文字或字符组成的数据。示例：I learned how to use "string" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“分支”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。branch：分支，从主代码线分出来的独立工作线。示例：Our team uses "branch" to keep the project clear.main branch：主分支，项目默认和最重要的代码线。示例：Our team uses "main branch" to keep the project clear.feature branch：功能分支，专门开发某项功能的分支。示例：Our team uses "feature branch" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“分支”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。create a branch：创建分支，建立新的独立工作线。示例：Our team uses "create a branch" to keep the project clear.switch branches：切换分支，从一条工作线转到另一条。示例：Our team uses "switch branches" to keep the project clear.branch name：分支名称，用来说明分支用途的名字。示例：Our team uses "branch name" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。
